clips.caption: archon — the fleet TUI (agent=fake), empty grid
Dispatch a task: type a prompt for a new session
Enter runs it on the ACP agent — session completes
Attach (down then Enter): the streamed agent reply
Send a follow-up prompt — streams live in the attached view
Esc detaches back to the grid
w — filter to sessions that need input
Ctrl+X stops the session and arms a 2s delete confirm
